QuestInfo.name: Edelstein City Mayor's Removal Vote
QuestInfo.0: Anthony looks excited about something and has a favor to ask of you.
QuestInfo.1: The poeple of town has started their deliberations against Albert as Anthony requested. Anthony is requesting that you pass out the #r#t4033839##k to the people of town.
QuestInfo.2: You've passed out the voting papers for Albert's removal.

0.0: Success is imminent! We're going to vote soon about whether Albert should step down. As someone who cares only for the good of Edelstein, I will be managing the process. I need your help with a little something.

yes.0: Pass out these #r#t4033839##k items to the good people of Edelstein. Well, don't bother with the people who look like they'll vote 'no.' They don't need any.

no.0: It is unwise to refuse me. Soon, I will be the most powerful person in the city.

1.0: Have you passed out the ballets? Excellent! The results should be in this afternoon. I hope you voted, too?

default.0: Pass out these #r#t4033839##k items to people in Edelstein so they can vote!
